sources: https://www.winnebagoforest.org/camping (read 2026-11-13): 'The campgrounds provide paved access roads, running water, electric hookups, restrooms, and dump stations. Winter Camping is no longer permitted.' 'Water has been shut off at campgrounds as of Monday, November 9. The final day to utilize campgrounds is Wednesday, November 18. Campgrounds will be closed for the 2026 season on Thursday, November 19.' Hononegah: 'No reservations available for sites at Hononegah, sites are on a first-come first-served basis. The host will register campers on a per unit basis after the units are established.' Fees, Seward Bluffs & Hononegah: '$15/unit' resident / '$25/unit' non-resident; Senior (62+) & disabled $13 / $23; 'Electric hookup (additional)' $10 / $10; 'A credit card convenience fee of 3% will be applied to all transactions'; '3 unit per site maximum (Tent-max of 3; RV-max of 1 & up to 2 tents)'
https://www.winnebagoforest.org/items/hononegah (read 2026-11-13): 'located on the north bank of the Rock River and bisected by Dry Run Creek'; 'Drinking Water: Yes'; 'Campground Sites: 57'

Hononegah Forest Preserve Campground map (winnebagoforest.org PDF 16e5c7_e55f3c0007e3492fa5f9aa926eb53177.pdf, read 2026-11-13): Electric and Primitive sites numbered to 61, Host, Dump Station, Water Spigot, Hand Pump, Outhouses; no shower building
Forest Preserves of Winnebago County Overnight Camping Policies (PDF b853e0_43919fcfc85f402093e07700249fa3c2.pdf, read 2026-11-13): 'use will be limited to a maximum of 14 consecutive nights'

Esri World_Imagery (42.4390,-89.0430, 450 m half-width): the stored pin is at the preserve entrance on Hononegah Road; the campground loops lie ~0.5 km SSW in the woods west of a subdivision, matching the map

facilities.source: https://www.winnebagoforest.org/camping ('running water, electric hookups, restrooms, and dump stations') + Hononegah campground map PDF (Water Spigot, Hand Pump, Outhouse, Dump Station), read 2026-11-13

values.note: Closed in winter ('Winter Camping is no longer permitted'); the 2026 season ended November 19. Water is shut off when freezing weather arrives. No opening date is published.

booking.source: https://www.winnebagoforest.org/camping ('No reservations available for sites at Hononegah, sites are on a first-come first-served basis') + Overnight Camping Policies PDF ('maximum of 14 consecutive nights'), read 2026-11-13

values.note: Seniors (62+) and disabled campers pay $2 less. A 3% card fee applies.

fees.source: https://www.winnebagoforest.org/camping (Seward Bluffs & Hononegah: $15/unit resident, $25/unit non-resident, electric hookup $10 additional, senior/disabled $13/$23, 3% card fee; the page carries the 2026 season-closing notice), read 2026-11-13

note: Winnebago County forest preserve near Rockton on the north bank of the Rock River; the campground loops sit in oak-hickory woods along Dry Run Creek, well back from the river. The host registers campers once they have set up. --Claude
summary: FPWC camping page, preserve page, campground map and camping policy read. Confirmed FCFS only (host registers), 57 sites, water/outhouses/dump; fees written ($15 resident / $25 non-resident per unit, +$10 electric, 2026); max stay 14. Stored season year_round contradicted ('Winter Camping is no longer permitted', closed Nov 19 2026) -> year_round false with note. Amps not published (stored 50 left). Pin is the entrance, ~530 m from the loops.

RATE SOURCE: winnebagoforest.org camping page, undated fee table shown with the 2026 season-closing notice -> checked 2026. Resident $15/unit, non-resident $25/unit, electric +$10 for both; senior/disabled $13/$23; 3% card fee. Residency here is Winnebago County (forest preserve district) - the page says only 'Resident / Non-resident'.
BOOKING: no reservations at Hononegah (Sugar River and Seward Bluffs are reservable online, Hononegah is not); stored reservable false / fcfs always confirmed, platform none added.

HOOKUPS: the page says only 'electric hookups'; no amperage published. Stored electric 50 (derived from old note prose '20/30/50A') left unconfirmed; inclusion_evidence's '30/60A' has no current source either. No water or sewer at sites (map shows a spigot and hand pump).
FIT: no length limit or pad sizes published; 'RV-max of 1' per site, paved access roads. Nothing suggests a 23-ft rig does not fit.
SHOWERS: stored showers false left (map shows outhouses only, no shower building; not stated in words).
PHONE: stored 815-877-6100 not found on the pages read (the Wix pages carry no phone in their text); left unconfirmed.
WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' confirmed - the Rock River is several hundred metres south; Dry Run Creek is a small creek in a wooded ravine.
